notes.title: The Elder Scrolls: Arena - Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
A small update has been made to The Elder Scrolls: Arena. Please find the list of patch notes below. 

Added the following reference materials: [list]
[*] Codex Scientia   
[*] Game Manual
[*] Player Guide
[*] Quick Reference Card [/list]
Adjusted cycle timing to smooth out animations
Updated game to Deluxe CD Version [list]
[*] Adds VO to cutscenes
[*] Adds a few CGI cutscenes [/list]
